title: Private Console: Tenant Health Sparkline Canvas prototype
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Problem: Private/VPC customers need a compact, glanceable surface in the Console that shows tenant-level health across networking, inference latency, error rates, and cost exposure (eg. egress + quantized GPU-hours). Existing cluster pages are dense and require multiple clicks to assess whether a tenant is at risk when a rollout is in progress or when an autoscaler is thrashes. Goal: design a small, embeddable 'Tenant Health Sparkline Canvas' card for the Private Console that can be tiled on the Ops Overview and on each tenant detail page. The card should communicate short-term trends (1h/6h/24h), recent anomalies, and actionable signals (eg. open rollback, throttle, open incident) while preserving privacy boundaries and supporting per-tenant RBAC. Constraints: must render in compact form (60-120px height), support streaming updates (sub-1m cadence), degrade gracefully in low-data scenarios, and avoid showing raw cost values unless user has billing permission. Success metrics: reduce time-to-first-action for tenant incidents by 25% in pilot customers, and reduce clicks-to-rollback from overview by 40%.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas renders in list view with sparkline, colored state chip, and a 3-dot action menu
Hover or tap expands to a 240px mini-panel with 4 metrics: p95 latency, error rate, cost burn, and active rollouts
Indicators show anomaly badges when metric crosses configured thresholds and link to incident runbook
Design respects RBAC: cost values masked if user lacks billing view permission
Prototype implemented in Figma with interactive hover/expand states and tokenized color variables

comments: PM - Ravi Mehta (2025-02-16): Love the compact approach. Please add explicit 'rollout in progress' wiring and a quick action to pause canaries.
Eng - Lina Gomez (2025-02-18): Backend can emit p50/p95/error-rate/cost-per-tenant; need an API change request filed. Also suggest limiting sparkline resolution to 1-min to avoid UI pressure.
Security - Marco Li (2025-02-18): Flag: cost must be masked unless user has billing.view. Ensure audit logs are emitted for 'rollback' action.
Design - Aisha Raman (2025-02-19): Decided to use a 3-color state system (healthy/warning/critical) and small anomaly dot with tooltip detailing threshold crossing time.
PM - Ravi (2025-02-20): Requesting A/B variant where the canvas shows network egress on hover for customers with multi-region VPCs. Add to follow-up scope if pilot goes well.
decisions: Use sparkline + colored chip + compact action menu as the default compact view
Hover-to-expand pattern chosen over inline expansion to preserve list density
Mask cost numbers unless billing.view permission is present; show relative cost change percent for non-billing users
Rollout quick-action will trigger a guarded API that creates an incident and attempts canary pause; requires audit log and two-step confirmation
notes_for_engineering: API: add endpoint /tenant-metrics/summary that returns 1m buckets for last 24h plus 'recent_rollouts' array
Performance: frontend should lazy-load sparkline images for >50 cards on page; stream updates via SSE only when card is in viewport
Observability: include links in tooltip to full Trace and to tenant's per-route cost breakdown in Optimize
